## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `ImportAnIntegrationToWso2Clo`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `import-integration`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **ImportAnIntegrationToWso2Clo**.

## Step 2: Import the integration

1. <!-- manual: Select the organization that owns the repository. -->
2. <!-- manual: Select the repository and the branch. -->
3. <!-- manual: Set the path to the folder where your integration lives within the repository. -->
4. <!-- manual: Optionally, add a description. -->
5. <!-- manual: Select the integration type. WSO2 Cloud detects the technology automatically. -->
6. Select **Create**.
